pc.title: Gill
pc.content:
Gill, the triton artificer, came to the Copper Dawn festival to explore the city and see what inventions could be made. He met Elly and joined the party's commission for the Celestial Droplet. He sometimes would watch Riven (not knowing him yet) perform by the seaside from a distance while trying to put the puzzle in his head together. 

The magic affecting Gill seems to be a topic banned by the Celestials. Raised by Meryll the mermaid. Gill's inventions include a spear that returns to him, an upgrade to Corey's weapon, and a turtle named Robert

pc.title: Corelia Harrendyl
pc.content:
Aasimar Samurai Fighter, a friend of Mozzie the devil, currently looking for an item that used to belong to her family. Helped interrogate Gill for mozzie. She has been hearing voices: "Return the final piece, and reawaken the ship." They have stopped once we got the ship.

does not let everyone call her Cory, lets Gill now after feeling bad about interrogating him

she has asked for our help to take care of the head of the thieves guild, a teifling by the name of Elizar

pc.title: Riven
pc.content: The sea elf bard that cannot go into the sea, likely because of a curse from some kind of powerful being/god. He loves the sea, but the sea does not love him; bad things happen if he enters the water. He was once part of a troupe with Elly and Blue (possibly childhood friends), now bartends at the Royal Seadog, and seems connected to information/criminal circles. The person tied to the curse may have been someone he loved named Lori. He has not been home for around 100 years as a result.

pc.title: Rhaekar
pc.content: Student of Talon Malsir. Originally from the Shadowfell. May have noble heritage, unsure. Hears voices in his head and is prone to spontaneous teleporting and wild surges. Raven King apparently tried to warn his family. Parents are dead. insane

pc.title: Blue
pc.content: Sapphire dragonborn bard (Blue/Tiff, with Tiff seeming to be a personal name). Was once part of a troupe with Riven and Elly. Alandra said it feels like two people are constantly present around Blue, and Blue's dreams are very present: "Someone is constantly betraying you, and they don't know it themselves."

npc.title: Talon Malsir
npc.content:
One of the great heroes, a wild-magic sorcerer who helped defeat the Pale Silence, now a resident celebrity living in Alsicta, mentor/master of Rhaekar. Father of Soren Malsir. Seems to have issues; best not to press. At one point, he encountered the dragonborn known as the Golden Flame, possibly the original one. He also announced the hunt for the Celestial Droplet on behalf of Alsita's government.

At one point went to gildhammer to meet with frosthelm

npc.title: Unknown Captain of the Riverwalker/Former
npc.content:
Seen in a vision (the same one Corelia saw). Going by an alias right now, cannot remember his name. His first mate is not here (the other one in the vision). Remembers vaguely the man he traveled with and believes his friend was not a good person. Was able to sense some sort of magic from Blue and Riven, then associated it with Gill. He and Gill are on much better terms now.

In the vision in the tomb, he is seen with an older gentleman holding an ornate dagger, cleaning the seas one step at a time. the dagger is the same as the same from the deep gaurd.

event.title: DREAM BATTLES
event.content: For some reason, in Riven's dreams, he or something has been dragging party members into his dreams to fight some sort of shadow demon. Currently, Corelia and Rahkar have been sent into these dreams. Mozzie showed up to aid Corelia, and Rhaekar got a boost from his voices in his head. Xim described Riven's dreams as terrifying and almost alive. we feel it may be safe to assume that the next victum is between blue or gill

event.title: The quest from jonik
event.content: He has certain access to things under the city where they buried the honored dead: sewers, catacombs, offerings/treasure, the Tomb of Rememberance. He wanted something returned to him (a rapier) and warned us about undead, cave-ins, and a locked gate tied to Gate Crasher. The rapier is with the body of Gate Crasher.

item.title: Celestial Droplet
item.content: Only rumors at this point. Some relate it to a kids' book. Some attribute it to the dragon that attacked, which could be in Alsita, maybe the government stole it. 1 million gp bounty. Droplet with blue and purple tints. Emanates energy of storm clouds and arcana, magical and religious importance. Orphon linked it to post-Pale Silence changes around River of Souls beliefs and free will.

item.title: Party Crasher
item.content:
Weapon (light hammer), (requires attunement)

Hidden in the rubble of the Tomb of Remembrance, Partycrasher is an expertly forged hammer engraved with goblin scripture. The hammer flies through the air with overwhelming force when thrown, being especially effective against structures and constructs.

You gain a +1 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls made with this magic weapon.

You may make a ranged weapon attack with this weapon as a bonus action so long as the weapon isn't currently equipped. When you hit with a ranged attack using this weapon, it deals an extra 1d4 Force damage, or an extra 4d4 Force damage if the target is a Construct. Immediately after hitting or missing, the weapon reforms back in your hand (or wherever it was thrown from).

Sentience. Partycrasher is a sentient lawful neutral weapon with an Intelligence of 11, a Wisdom of 16, and a Charisma of 15. It has hearing and darkvision out to a range of 120 feet.
The weapon communicates telepathically with its wielder and can speak both Common and Goblin. While attuned or holding it, the wielder gains the ability to speak, read, and understand Goblin.
